name: ext-agent
description: Run Claude Code subagents in pi or opencode instead of a Claude model. Adds the ext-agent:worker agent type; built-in subagents stay available unless you opt in to blocking them.

blockBuiltin.title: Block built-in subagents
blockBuiltin.description: Off (default): ext-agent:worker is added next to the built-in agent types. On: only ext-agent:worker can be dispatched; the built-in types are hidden and refused.

defaultModel.title: Default model
defaultModel.description: Used when an Agent call names none: "pi" or "opencode" (the CLI's own default model), or "pi:<provider>/<model>[:<thinking>]" / "opencode:<provider/model[#variant]>".

worktreeLayout.title: Worktree layout
worktreeLayout.description: Where `worktree:` / isolation "worktree" puts the checkout. "claude" (default): <repo>/.claude/worktrees/<name> on branch worktree-<name>, as Claude Code does (honours the worktree.baseRef setting). "sibling": <repo>-wt/<name> on branch wip/<name>, off main. Any other value counts as "claude".

stallMinutes.title: Stall limit (minutes)
stallMinutes.description: A worker whose pi / opencode process prints nothing for this long while no tool call runs is stopped and the Agent call answers that it stalled. 0 turns the check off.

toolStallMinutes.title: Stall limit during a tool call (minutes)
toolStallMinutes.description: The same, while a tool call (a build, a test run, a render) has started and not finished. Longer, because those print nothing on purpose. 0 turns the check off.
